description:
Venue season tickets; park season passes (unlimited entries during validity, named holder with photo binding, anti-sharing); multi-park passes valid across parks.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Venue season ticket grants the holder's seat across a season's performances
- Park pass admits the named holder unlimited times within validity; gate shows holder photo
- Multi-park pass validates at any covered park; entitlement checks go through the inventory core

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

**Amended (grilling):** per ADR-005, passes are entitlements to claim slot entries (park pass = unlimited entry claims on operating-day slots; venue season ticket = seat claims across a season's slots).

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.
Backlog grilling 2026-07-12 (owner decisions): pass semantics grounded in ADR-005 dated-slot model.
